Third-party files in web/vendor (all used unmodified; nothing is fetched from a CDN at runtime)
==============================================================================================

pdf-lib.min.js        pdf-lib 1.17.1 (UMD build), MIT License, Copyright (c) 2019 Andrew Dillon
                      https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib  (copied from poc/browser-only/vendor,
                      originally downloaded from jsDelivr). Contains tslib (Apache-2.0, Microsoft)
                      and pako (MIT) as noted in the file's own headers.
                      sha256 0f9a5cad07941f0826586c94e089d89b918c46e5c17cf2d5a3c6f666e3bc694f

fontkit.umd.min.js    @pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1 (UMD build), MIT License, Copyright (c) 2014 Devon
                      Govett (fontkit) and the pdf-lib authors (fork)
                      https://github.com/Hopding/fontkit  (copied from poc/browser-only/vendor,
                      originally downloaded from jsDelivr).
                      sha256 d8df561b9fba98e24f2e5130e40948809281bbbc55a20c412359f1a0a5eb35a6

Carlito-Regular.ttf   Carlito (metric-compatible with Calibri), SIL Open Font License 1.1,
Carlito-Bold.ttf
Carlito-Italic.ttf    Copyright 2013 The Carlito Project Authors, Reserved Font Name "Carlito".
                      https://github.com/googlefonts/carlito  (fonts/ttf; Regular and Bold downloaded 2026-10-20, Italic 2026-10-21).
                      Full licence: Carlito-OFL.txt. The files are unmodified; for embedding,
                      web/engine/fonts.js pads the glyph records in memory (works around a
                      fontkit 1.1.1 subsetting bug) and pdf-lib subsets them into each PDF, as
                      the OFL allows for documents.
                      sha256 f6418f708baede9789daef5d458c0f53d2a888af9820e8062934e504fedc6595 (Regular)
                      sha256 bb5d20f79b82599ec72983597437373a80f2d2085fa91fc144fd74e876a594db (Bold)
                      sha256 0b019225e58d702bfedcbd35c21696769f8ee115cb6343f84c2f240312450d1c (Italic)

The three fonts and the NoeXa logo are also inside web/engine/assets.js as base64
(generated by web/tools/build_assets.py).
